snippet.title: Djinn - The Forbidden Knowledge - Gameplay
snippet.description:
#djinn #horror #pcgame

Djinn is an exploration-focused game that also incorporates action, platforming, and light puzzles. Despite its challenging old-school style with roguelite elements, it doesn't punish you by making you lose the inventory items upon death, allowing for steady progression. It's crucial to collect notes that unveil the story, lore, and environment's secrets as you explore and face off against various enemies and even some bosses. Resource management is also key, as you'll need to find and strategically use items to maintain your health, stamina, and sanity as you immerse further into this adventure.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2941750/Djinn__The_Forbidden_Knowledge

Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/djinn-the-forbidden-knowledge-1f5924
